title: The Relevant Woman ACADEMY (RWA)
description:
Register today and begin a journey of transformation.

The Relevant Woman Academy offers a comprehensive program designed to empower women through personal and professional development.

This virtual program provides:

  • Official Certification from The Relevant Woman Academy
  • Training led by top professionals and industry experts
  • Featured exposure in The Relevant Woman Magazine
  • Exclusive access to partner-sponsored opportunities and awards

Key Benefits:

  • Become deeply rooted in your identity
  • Master self-leadership
  • Gain clarity on purpose/assignment/calling
  • Acquire transferable career excellence
  • Cultivate a wealthy mindset
  • Develop and lead others effectively
  • Become a powerful communicator and public speaker

title: Her Money, Her Power
description:
An interactive program delving into the crucial question: Is financial independence the ultimate source of power for women?

Join us for an engaging session that explores the multifaceted relationship between money and power for women.

Key Discussion Points:

  • The importance of financial literacy for women
  • How financial independence can empower women

Key Benefits:

  • Gain insights into the importance of financial literacy for women
  • Understand how financial independence can empower women
  • Learn practical steps to achieve financial independence
  • Engage in discussions about the broader implications of money and power for women

title: Fireside Chat themed: Functioning From Wholeness💜
description:
This powerful session will bring together remarkable women who are not only building impactful brands but also living authentically and thriving from a place of wholeness.

It’s a space to learn, reflect, and grow as you hear real stories, practical insights, and empowering conversations.

Featuring:

  • Iveren Ann Lyam – Founder, The Relevant Woman
  • Blessing Ingyape – Founder, Dyslexia Help Africa, Forgex Academy & Dyslexia Project Africa
  • Salomé Ingyape – Content Creator & Social Media/Community Manager

Key Benefits:

  • Hear real stories, practical insights, and empowering conversations
  • Reflect on your own journey and growth
  • Connect with a community of like-minded women
  • Gain insights into building impactful brands while living authentically
  • Cultivate a wealthy mindset

title: Advertise with The Relevant Woman Growing Your Brand
description:
In honor of International Women’s Day, The Relevant Woman celebrated women by spotlighting women-owned businesses that have thrived for 3 years and above.

Showcase your brand to a growing community of women who support and uplift each other. This is an opportunity to connect with a highly engaged audience and promote your products or services in a meaningful way.

Key Benefits:

  • Reach a targeted audience of empowered women
  • Increase brand visibility and awareness
  • Build meaningful connections with a community of like-minded individuals

title: Celebrating International Women's Day
description: This March 2026 , The relevant Woman celebrated the International Women’s by spotlighting bold, courageous and brilliant women who are building brands, breaking barriers and creating impact. 💜
